# Hostile [Attitude]

*[Rules Glossary](../index.md) > [Social Interaction](index.md) | [D&D Beyond](https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/br-2024/rules-glossary#HostileAttitude)*

A Hostile creature views you unfavorably. You have [Disadvantage](../D20-Tests/Disadvantage.md) on an ability check to influence a Hostile creature. *See also* "[Influence](../Combat/Actions/Influence.md)."
